scope: Independent static review of exact v0.2.529 primary-item Store ZIP for Blue Argon remotely hosted executable code

findings.detail: Immutable GitHub artifact digest, receipt source/tag, Store ZIP digest, ZIP CRC, and receipt local-release-tree hash independently verified.

No rejected PDFObject 2.1.1 cdnjs loader, remote HTML script, dynamic script insertion, remote import/importScripts, or remote worker source found. PDFObject references are local generator API/viewer error branches; the viewer branches throw that remote viewers are unavailable.
The exact Store manifest is MV3 v0.2.529, has no development key, and its normalized policy projection matches approved baseline 0.2.205.

Hosted release log reports package validation and CWS approval-risk gate passed, with @ai-matrx packages latest; package refresh is in tagged history. Release-owner reconciliation reports rich-content .205→.206 has no consumer action and requires no extension adapter.

evidence.scope: Exact hosted release 39083758486 artifact and Store ZIP

release.outer_artifact_digest_source: Downloaded immutable GitHub Actions artifact 12120082821 and compared raw archive SHA-256 with GitHub artifact metadata.

rejection_specific_policy.prior_rejection_reference: Google Blue Argon / routing ID FZSL rejection citing https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pdfobject/2.1.1/pdfobject.min.js
rejection_specific_policy.exact_zip_findings: Scanned emitted JS/HTML and included maps. No cdnjs PDFObject URL, remote HTML script src, remote dynamic import, importScripts, remote Worker/SharedWorker source, or dynamic script-src insertion loader found. PDF helper uses API.PDFObject.convert; pdfobjectnewwindow/pdfjsnewwindow branches throw remote-viewers-unavailable errors.
rejection_specific_policy.runtime_code_paths: No actual eval call, case-sensitive new Function constructor call, Chrome runtime execution token, remote module loader, or script insertion loader found. Text such as `new function` in bundled libraries is ordinary syntax.
rejection_specific_policy.remote_assets: Bundled KaTeX CSS contains jsDelivr font-face URLs for WOFF/WOFF2/TTF assets. These are remote fonts, not executable code; static review does not establish their runtime availability or Store approval.
rejection_specific_policy.scan_scope: All 1,242 JS files, 4 HTML files, and 1,068 source maps in the exact Store ZIP; exact ZIP risk gate rerun passed. Bounded static evidence only.

integrity_and_baseline.hosted_release_evidence: Exact hosted run passed package validation and Chrome Web Store approval-risk gate. Release owner confirms rich-content .205→.206 consumer action is none; no extension adapter is required.

limits: This is exact-artifact static review; it does not establish Store upload, submission, dashboard state, review outcome, or acceptance.
Remote KaTeX font asset URLs are present; they are not executable-code loaders and this review makes no Store-policy determination about those assets.
No native browser/member acceptance is claimed.

evidence.verification_method: Verified immutable GitHub artifact digest against API metadata; matched receipt source to tag and current origin/main; matched inner Store ZIP digest and CRC to receipt; confirmed local release tree hash from receipt; inspected release and hosted risk-gate evidence; compared exact Store manifest policy projection to approved baseline; scanned emitted JS, HTML, and maps for rejected PDFObject CDN and remote executable-code patterns; reran exact-zip risk gate.

open_questions: This review makes no claim about Store upload, submission, dashboard state, or Google acceptance.
